fields.Brief Abstract: This study assesses flash-drought climatology and agricultural exposure across the southeastern United States using four indicators: the U.S. Drought Monitor, evaporative stress index, soil moisture volatility index, and lawn and garden index. By relating drought occurrence and timing to regional crop calendars and critical growing periods, the authors identify seasonal and geographic patterns of vulnerability that can inform agricultural drought monitoring and decision support.
